items.title: Reducedness ascends along a regular map from a reduced Noetherian ring
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-algebra.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that a Noetherian target of a regular ring map from a reduced Noetherian ring is again reduced. The proof uses the criterion that for Noetherian rings reducedness is equivalent to the conjunction of the two conditions (S_1) and (R_0), and then applies the two corresponding ascent statements for these conditions along a regular map, which give both conditions for the target and hence reducedness.
